problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}y+2z=0 \\ x+2y+3z=2 \\ 3x+y+z=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & a & 2 \\ b & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$

activity_context.topic_title: Representing 3x3 Systems of Equations Using a Matrix Product
